help_purpose: The main tasks in Dwello, step by step.
help_buildings_1: Under «Buildings» you add a building with its address, postcode, town and year built.
help_buildings_2: Under «Apartments» or on the building’s detail page you add the apartments with apartment number, floor, area and number of rooms.
help_buildings_3: The area is the basis for distribution keys by area, so enter it accurately.
help_tenants_1: Under «Tenants» you add the tenants with their contact details and correspondence channel (letter or email).
help_tenants_2: Under «Rental contracts», «Add rental contract» guides you through the contract in five steps: tenant, apartment, contract term, rent and review. «Back» and «Next» move between the steps without losing your entries.
help_tenants_3: Only «Save rental contract» in the last step creates the rental contract. Until you save, discard the draft or sign out, your entries stay as a draft in this browser.
help_tenants_4: When a tenancy ends, enter the contract end in the rental contract. The apartment then counts as vacant again.
help_tenants_5: On a tenant’s page you upload files under «Upload a document», such as a handover report (PDF, JPG or PNG, at most 10 MB). Delete copies of ID documents and debt collection register extracts as soon as you no longer need them.
help_invoices_1: Under «Invoices» you add each invoice from an invoice issuer with its date, amount and building.
help_invoices_2: Every invoice belongs to a category. Only invoices in allocable categories go into the utility cost statements.
help_invoices_3: You maintain categories, distribution keys and heating profiles under «Categories», «Distribution keys» and «Heating profiles», and defaults such as the billing period under «Settings».
help_invoices_4: Several invoices at once: under «Invoices», choose «Upload invoices». The AI reads the files, and you check the details before Dwello creates the invoices.
help_statements_1: Under «Utility cost statements», «Create statements» guides you in five steps: billing period, buildings, heating profile and management fee, preview and create.
help_statements_2: In the preview you check the costs: Dwello shares them out by distribution key and, when tenants change or an apartment is vacant, bills them by days rented. Only «Create drafts» creates the statements.
help_statements_3: The statements are then available as drafts. You can change the payment deadline and the notes; to correct wrong costs, create the statements again.
help_statements_4: Dwello does not send the statements itself. Deliver the PDF to the tenant by letter or email, then choose «Mark as sent». The payment deadline runs from that day.
help_payments_1: The «Overview» shows you overdue statements and upcoming deadlines.
help_payments_2: When a payment comes in, choose «Mark as paid» in the statement.
help_payments_3: When the payment deadline has passed, «Send reminder» issues a payment reminder first, then a 2nd or 3rd reminder. It goes by email or as a letter, depending on the tenant’s correspondence channel.
help_payments_4: Letters appear under «Documents». Mark a letter as sent there on the day you post it, then print it: only then does it carry that day’s date and a new payment deadline.
glossary_period_text: The year for which you bill the utility costs, for example the calendar year or July to June. Without a service period, the invoice date decides which billing period an invoice belongs to. With a service period, its days in the billing period count.
glossary_advance_text: The tenant’s monthly advance for the utility costs. The utility cost statement sets it off against the actual costs.
glossary_net_rent_text: The monthly base rent, without utility costs.
glossary_additional_rent_text: Extra monthly rent, for example for a garage, parking space or cellar.
glossary_key_text: The rule by which a building’s costs are shared among the apartments, for example by area, by rooms or the same for each apartment.
glossary_profile_text: Spreads the heating costs over the 12 months in percent, because more heating is used in winter than in summer. If a tenant moves in or out during the billing period, Dwello splits their heating costs by month instead of by day. You choose the heating profile when you create the statements.
glossary_fee_text: The compensation for your management work: a percentage of each tenant’s own utility costs. Only allowed if agreed in the rental contract; you record that with the rental contract. About 3 % is usual; a higher rate must match your actual work. You choose the rate when you create the statements, unless the rental contract states its own.
glossary_days_text: The number of days a rental contract runs in the billing period. If a tenant moves in or out during the billing period, they pay only the share of their days rented and, for heating costs with a heating profile, the share of their months. The landlord bears the costs of the days an apartment stands vacant.
glossary_allocable_text: An allocable invoice goes into the utility cost statement, for example heating, water, caretaker or refuse. Whether an invoice is allocable follows from its category; you can exclude a single invoice of an allocable category. The tenant only has to pay these costs if the rental contract lists them as utility costs.
glossary_balance_text: The tenant’s share of the costs including the management fee, minus their advance payments made, rounded to 5 centimes. If the balance is positive, the tenant pays the difference (amount due); if it is negative, they get money back (refund).
glossary_deadline_text: The date by which the tenant must have paid an amount due. For a refund, it is the date by which you transfer the amount to them («Refund by»).
glossary_reminder_text: A demand for payment that you issue for a sent statement with an amount due: first a payment reminder, then at most a 2nd and a 3rd reminder. To terminate the rental contract for late payment, you need a separate written payment deadline of at least 30 days that warns of termination; the reminders are not one.
glossary_channel_text: How a tenant receives post from you: by letter (default) or by email. Email needs an email address.
glossary_status_text: Shows whether an apartment is let: let (a rental contract is running), let from … (only a future rental contract has been signed), vacant or blocked. Let and let from … follow from the rental contracts; you set vacant and blocked when editing the apartment.
glossary_fixed_term_text: A fixed-term rental contract ends without notice on the agreed contract end. If the tenant then stays in the apartment and you let them stay without objecting, the contract becomes open-ended. An open-ended rental contract runs until notice of termination is given.
glossary_termination_date_text: A day for which an open-ended rental contract can be terminated: a date set in the rental contract or, if it sets none, a date customary in the area. After a notice of termination, it is the day the contract was terminated for. Until then the contract keeps running and is called terminated by notice.
glossary_notice_period_text: The time between receipt of the notice of termination and the termination date. For apartments it is at least 3 months, or longer if the rental contract says so. If the notice arrives too late, it applies to the next termination date. Other periods apply to extraordinary terminations, for example for late payment. The rental contract only ends earlier if you agree on the end with the tenant or a replacement tenant takes it over.
glossary_manual_text: You changed the category the AI suggested for an invoice yourself. You can give the reason for the change when editing. The invoice list then shows «Manual», as for every invoice whose category you chose yourself.

privacy_purpose: Which data Dwello processes and where it goes.
privacy_llm_external: Invoices are categorised by {provider} ({country}) using an AI, which also reads uploaded invoice files. If you choose files under “Upload invoices”, each one is transmitted at once with its file name (of PDF files at most the first three pages, as images), even if you cancel the upload afterwards; it contains everything on the invoice, names and addresses included. For the category, the invoice issuer (including individuals), the description and the amount of the invoice as well as the name and description of all categories are transmitted. If you have the AI check a new category, its name and description are transmitted so that the AI can suggest whether its costs are allocable. If this information contains a name, it is transmitted as well.
privacy_llm_local: Invoices are categorised with an AI, which also reads uploaded invoice files; on request it also checks whether the costs of new categories are allocable. The AI runs on the operator’s server; the data does not leave the server for this.
privacy_llm_off: Invoices and categories are not processed by an AI.
privacy_stored_1: Dwello stores the data needed to manage the buildings and bill the utility costs: buildings and apartments, tenants with contact details and correspondence address, rental contracts, invoices, documents you upload for tenants (such as handover reports, copies of ID documents or debt collection register extracts), and the statements created, payments and reminders. The supporting documents (uploaded files of the invoices with everything on them, such as names, addresses and amounts) make it easier for tenants to inspect them and stay stored until you replace the supporting document or delete the invoice.
privacy_stored_2: The data is kept in the PostgreSQL database of the operator of this Dwello installation.
privacy_login_1: You sign in through {providers}. Dwello receives the name, email address and profile picture of the account and uses them to run the session and show the name in the header. Every sign-in and every extension of the session (about every 50 minutes while Dwello is open) is recorded with the email address in the server log. Dwello never sees passwords.
privacy_third_1: Payment reminders and further reminders sent by email are delivered through the mail service set up by the operator (its own SMTP server or Resend). The tenant’s name and email address and the content of the message are transmitted.
privacy_third_3: The address search when you add a building asks OpenPLZ (openplzapi.org) for matching addresses. OpenPLZ receives the browser’s IP address and the search term you enter.
privacy_third_4: «Plan route» in the building list opens Google Maps with the building’s address. Google receives the address and the browser’s IP address only when you choose the link.
privacy_third_5: Apart from the services named here and under «Sign-in», no one receives data from Dwello.
privacy_cookies_1: Dwello sets only technically necessary cookies. No tracking or advertising cookies are used.
privacy_cookies_2: «dwello_session» keeps you signed in; JavaScript cannot read it. «dwello_xsrf» protects against forged requests.
privacy_cookies_3: «dwello_oauth_state» protects the sign-in against forged answers, «dwello_login» remembers the chosen provider and the page that opens afterwards. Both last only during sign-in, at most 10 minutes.
privacy_cookies_4: «PARAGLIDE_LOCALE» stores the interface language for 400 days; JavaScript can read it. On the first visit Dwello sets it to your browser’s language if that is German, French, Italian or English, otherwise to German.
privacy_draft_notice: Dwello keeps unsaved entries in «Add rental contract» and «Create statements» as a draft in this browser until you save them, discard them or sign out. A draft may contain names and amounts; it stays on the device you are working on.
demo_notice_text: All visitors see and change the same data. Every night, all changes are deleted and the made-up sample data is loaded again. So enter only made-up data, including email addresses and phone numbers.
privacy_demo_1: This installation is a public demo: everyone who signs in sees and changes the same data, and every night all changes are deleted and the made-up sample data is loaded again. Other visitors do not see your name or email address; only the operator sees them in the server log (see «Sign-in»).

terms_responsibility_1: Dwello calculates the statements from the invoices, distribution keys and rental contracts entered. The property manager remains responsible for the accuracy of the data entered and for the statements sent. Every statement should be checked before it is sent.
terms_responsibility_2: The management is responsible for informing the tenants about the processing of their data.

buildings_fuel_title: Fuel in the tank or storage
buildings_fuel_intro: Only for buildings heated with oil, LPG, pellets or wood. What was consumed is billed: opening stock + purchases − closing stock. To do this, on the last day of each billing period, for example on 31.12., add the value in the tank or storage in francs. The value of 31.12.2024 is the closing stock 2024 and the opening stock 2025. Calculate the value like this: quantity in the tank or storage times the price per unit (litre, kg or stere, a cubic metre of stacked wood) of the last delivery. If the tank or storage holds more than the last delivery, calculate the rest at the price of the delivery before. If you only read the level at the beginning of January, still add the value as at 31.12.

contracts_confirm_past: {notice} If it is correct, click «Next» again.
contracts_draft_dropped: The chosen tenant or apartment no longer exists. Please choose again.
contracts_unlimited_help: The rental contract has no contract end. It runs until it is terminated.
contracts_limited_help: The rental contract ends on a fixed day, without notice of termination.
contracts_overlap_text: {overlap}. No two rental contracts of an apartment may overlap.
contracts_base_rent_help: Monthly base rent without utility costs.
contracts_advance_help: The tenant’s monthly advance for utility costs (heating, water, etc.). It is offset in the utility cost statement.
contracts_fee_help: Choose what the signed rental contract says. If it states a percentage, choose “Yes, with its own rate” and enter it. If it only says that management costs are charged, choose “Yes, at the rate of the statement run”: you then choose the rate when you create the statements. If it says nothing about it, choose “No”. A new management fee during the tenancy must be notified to the tenant with the official form; it applies only from the next termination date (Art. 269d CO).
contracts_fee_run: Yes, at the rate of the statement run
contracts_error_fee_choice: Please choose whether the rental contract agrees a management fee.
contracts_fee_shown_run: Agreed, rate of the statement run
statements_fee_not_agreed_text: No management fee is agreed for these rental contracts (as recorded with the rental contract). Their statements contain no fee (0 %). If the rental contract agrees one, record it there.
contracts_rent_taken_over_title: Amounts from the last rental contract
contracts_rent_taken_over_text: The amounts come from the last rental contract of this apartment ({period}). If an amount was 0.00 there, its field stays empty. Check the amounts and adjust them if others apply in the new rental contract.
contracts_rent_taken_over_additional: If, for example, the new tenant does not rent the parking space, clear the additional rent.
contracts_additional_help: Additional monthly rent, for example for a garage, parking space or cellar.
contracts_review_intro: Check the details. «Save rental contract» creates the rental contract.
contracts_tenant_created_text: {name} has been saved and selected for this rental contract.
invoices_error_service_end: Please also enter the end of the service period.
invoices_error_service_start: Please also enter the start of the service period.
invoices_error_service_order: The end cannot be before the start.
invoices_error_reason: Please give a reason for the change
invoices_purpose: The invoices of your buildings. Allocable invoices go into the utility cost statement.
invoices_empty_year_text: Add the invoices of this year so that they go into the utility cost statement.
invoices_empty_text: Add your first invoice so that it goes into the utility cost statement.
invoices_date_help: Copy the date from the invoice, not today’s date. Without a service period, it decides which billing period the invoice falls into.
invoices_service_period_help: What period does the invoice cover? Enter it for invoices covering a period, for example a quarter or a year. For the 4th quarter, that is 01.10.2024 to 31.12.2024, even if the invoice only arrives in January. Then only the days within the billing period count. Not for deliveries of heating oil, LPG, pellets or wood: their consumption counts through the building’s fuel stock.
invoices_outside_by_period: The service period is not within the billing period {start} – {end}. The invoice then does not go into these utility cost statements. Check the invoice date and the service period.
invoices_outside_by_date: The invoice date is not within the billing period {start} – {end}. The invoice then does not go into these utility cost statements. Check the invoice date and the service period.
invoices_billing_entity_help: Company or person issuing the invoice.
invoices_description_help: The service the invoice charges for.
invoices_key_help: How the costs are split among the building’s apartments. Without a distribution key, the costs are split equally per apartment.
invoices_allocable_help: The invoice goes into the utility cost statement.
invoices_not_allocable_help: The invoice does not go into the utility cost statement.
invoices_category_not_allocable_text: Costs in this category (e.g. repairs, building insurance) cannot be passed on to tenants.
invoices_billed_period: There are already statements with this invoice for the billing period {start} – {end}.
invoices_missed_period: There are already statements without this invoice for the billing period {start} – {end}.
invoices_missed_text: Delete the drafts of this period and create the statements again; the invoice is then included. Correct sent statements outside Dwello: send the tenant a corrected statement with the receipt. Whether you can still claim the costs is not certain in every case: if in doubt, seek advice.
invoices_ki_failed: The AI could not categorise the invoice.
invoices_save_failed: The invoice could not be saved. Please try again.
invoices_new_purpose: Add an invoice so that its costs go into the utility cost statement.
invoices_ki_active_text: As soon as the invoice issuer and description are entered, the AI suggests a category.
invoices_ki_reading: The AI is reading the invoice …
invoices_edit_purpose: Correct the invoice from {name}. Existing statements do not change.
invoices_edit_billed_text: If you change this invoice, these statements are no longer correct. Then delete the drafts and create the statements again. Correct sent or paid statements with the tenant outside Dwello; refund any overpayment.
invoices_override_reason_help: Why does the AI’s category not fit? The reason is saved with the invoice.
invoices_status_pending_long: Not categorised – please choose a category
invoices_delete_failed: The invoice could not be deleted. Please try again.
invoices_legal_title: Not in the utility cost statement
invoices_legal_text: This invoice is not included in the utility cost statement. Typical non-allocable costs: repairs, building insurance, property tax, mortgage interest (Art. 256 para. 1, 256b and 257a CO).
invoices_delete_text: The invoice from {name} for {amount} will be deleted. It will then no longer go into any new utility cost statement. This cannot be undone.
invoices_delete_billed_text: Delete only invoices recorded by mistake. The drafts still contain it: then delete the drafts and create the statements again. Correct sent or paid statements with the tenant outside Dwello and refund any overpayment. Keep the original invoice: the tenant may ask to inspect it.
invoices_upload_purpose: Choose the building and the files of your invoices. The AI reads the details; you check them before Dwello creates the invoices.
invoices_upload_files_label: Drag files here or choose them
invoices_upload_files_help: PDF, JPG or PNG, at most 10 MB each, up to 20 files at once. The AI reads the chosen files at once.
invoices_upload_too_many: You can upload at most 20 files at once. The others were not added.
invoices_upload_keep_original: Keep the original invoice; tenants may inspect it.
invoices_upload_kept: Dwello stores the file of each invoice created as its supporting document. Dwello does not store files you create no invoice from.
backend_extraction_unavailable: The AI is not available. Please fill in the fields.
backend_extraction_unreadable: The AI gave no readable answer. Choose “Try again” or fill in the fields.
invoices_upload_unreadable: Dwello cannot open this file. Please fill in the fields.
invoices_upload_read_failed: The file was not read because Dwello did not respond. Choose “Try again” or fill in the fields.
invoices_upload_unsure: The AI is not sure. Please check the value.
invoices_upload_more_pages: The AI only read the first {pages} pages. Check the amount and the items on the other pages.
invoices_upload_missing: The AI did not find this value. Fill it in if it is on the invoice.
invoices_upload_add_if_shown: Add if shown on the invoice: {fields}.
invoices_upload_building_locked: The building applies to all files. Remove the files to choose another one.
invoices_upload_duplicate: This invoice has already been entered.
invoices_upload_several: This file contains several invoices. Upload each invoice as a file of its own, or add each one with “Add invoice” and then attach this file on its page with “Add the supporting document”.
invoices_upload_deducted: Amounts already paid are deducted on the invoice ({amount}). The amount proposed is the total of the services before the deduction. Do not also enter the advance payments as separate invoices, or they count twice.
invoices_upload_reminder: This is a payment reminder. Reminder fees and default interest are not utility costs; enter the original invoice.
invoices_upload_credit_note: This is a credit note. Do not create an invoice from it. Reduce the amount of the invoice it belongs to by the credit note: here in its row or, if it is already entered, with “Edit invoice”. Keep the credit note with the original invoice.
invoices_upload_mixed: The invoice contains costs that are not allocable (e.g. repairs). Enter only the allocable amount here and enter the rest afterwards with “Add invoice” in the category Repairs.
invoices_upload_create_failed: The invoice was not created because Dwello did not respond. Please try again.
invoices_upload_none_selected: Choose at least one invoice to create.
invoices_upload_discard_text_created: Invoices already created stay saved. The other files and your entries will be lost.
invoices_upload_discard_text: Uploaded files and your entries will be lost.
backend_beleg_not_found: No supporting document is stored for this invoice.
invoices_beleg_file_help: PDF, JPG or PNG, at most 10 MB.
invoices_beleg_failed: The supporting document was not saved because Dwello did not respond. Please try again.
invoices_beleg_billed: The invoice has been billed; tenants may ask for the supporting document.
invoices_beleg_deducted: Amounts already paid are deducted on the supporting document ({amount}). Check that they count only once: if the amount is the total before the deduction, the advance invoices must not be entered as well.
invoices_beleg_mixed: The supporting document also contains costs that are not allocable (e.g. repairs). Check that the amount contains only the allocable part and that the rest is entered as a separate invoice in a non-allocable category.
invoices_delete_beleg_billed: Download the supporting document first if you need it for the tenant’s inspection.
invoices_beleg_how_replace: Choose the new file, then “Replace the supporting document”.
invoices_beleg_how_add: Choose the file, then “Add the supporting document”.
invoices_delete_beleg: The supporting document is deleted as well.
invoices_date_decides: Decides which billing period the invoice falls into.
invoices_service_period_days: Only the days within the billing period count.
invoices_no_key: None – the costs are split equally per apartment
categories_save_failed: The category could not be saved.
categories_delete_failed: The category could not be deleted.
documents_purpose: Reminders and other letters to tenants, and documents you uploaded for tenants. Mark a letter as sent on the day you post it: Dwello then puts that day’s date and a new payment deadline on it. Then print the letter and post it the same day.
documents_update_failed: The document could not be updated.
documents_empty_text: Reminders and documents you upload for a tenant appear here.
documents_print_now: The letter now carries today’s date and a new payment deadline. Print it now and post it today.
statements_paid_help_refund: The day you transferred the amount.
statements_paid_date_invalid: Please enter the payment date as DD.MM.YYYY.
statements_paid_date_future: The payment date is in the future. Enter the day the money arrived.
statements_paid_date_before: The payment date is before the statement date of {date}. Enter this date or a later one.
statements_reset_payment_text: Statement {number} then counts as unpaid again and has the status “{status}”. The payment date {date} is deleted. The history records the reset.
statements_reset_payment_done: The payment of statement {number} has been reset.
statements_reset_payment_failed: The payment could not be reset. Please try again.
statements_error_period_start: Please choose the start of the billing period.
statements_error_period_end: Please choose the end of the billing period.
statements_error_period_order: The end must be after the start of the billing period.
statements_error_fee: Please enter a percentage from 0 to 10 with at most two decimal places, for example 3 or 2.5.
statements_error_buildings: Please choose at least one building.
statements_finding_gap_one: Invoice for {parts} is missing. Previous year: {invoices}.
statements_finding_gap_many: Invoices for {parts} are missing. Previous year: {invoices}.
statements_finding_stock_tail: Without opening and closing stock, Dwello bills the purchases, not the consumption. But you may only bill the consumption: add the stock on the building’s page. Only confirm if the tank was equally full at the start and at the end.
statements_finding_stock_negative: The closing stock is {amount} higher than the opening stock and purchases together; the consumption would be negative. Check the fuel stocks.
statements_finding_missing: No invoice added in this category. Previous year: costs of {amount}.
statements_finding_new: New: {amount}, no costs in the previous year. Is this category agreed in the rental contract? You may only bill agreed utility costs. If not, mark the invoices as not allocable. You can introduce new utility costs only for the future, at the earliest for the next termination date: with reasons, on the official form, received by the tenant at least 10 days before the notice period begins. Without the form or reasons the change is void. If the costs were included in the net rent so far, lower it accordingly.
statements_finding_more: {amount}, {percent} % more than in the previous year ({previous}). Check the amount and the period the invoice covers.
statements_finding_less: {amount}, {percent} % less than in the previous year ({previous}). Check the amount and the period the invoice covers.
statements_finding_partial_one: 1 invoice counts only in part: its service period reaches beyond the billing period.
statements_finding_partial_many: {count} invoices count only in part: their service periods reach beyond the billing period.
statements_late_title: Invoices shortly after the billing period
statements_late_text: These invoices have no service period. They therefore count in the billing period of their invoice date, not in this one. If one of them belongs to this billing period, enter its service period.
statements_whole_text: The billing period is shorter than a year. These invoices have no service period and therefore count with their whole amount. If one covers more than this billing period, for example a whole year, enter its service period. Then only the part of the amount that falls into this billing period counts.
statements_akonto_above: Costs are {amount} ({percent} %) above the advance payments.
statements_akonto_raise: Check whether to raise the advance payment. An increase takes effect at the earliest from the next termination date: with reasons, on the official form, received by the tenant at least 10 days before the notice period begins. Without the form or reasons it is void.
statements_akonto_below: Costs are {amount} ({percent} %) below the advance payments. Are invoices missing?
statements_mark_paid_failed: The statement could not be marked as paid. Please try again.
statements_reminder_failed: The reminder could not be created.
statements_purpose: Check, send and track your tenants’ statements.
statements_scope_contract: You are seeing the statements of the rental contract of {tenant}, apartment {apartment} ({building}), contract start {start}.
statements_scope_period: You are seeing the statements of the billing period {start} – {end}.
statements_empty_text: Create your first utility cost statement.
statements_no_reminder_after: After that you can no longer send a reminder.
statements_send_failed: The statement could not be sent.
statements_delete_failed: The statement could not be deleted.
statements_later_one: 1 invoice for the billing period has been added that is not included
statements_later_many: {count} invoices for the billing period have been added that are not included
statements_later_draft: Since this draft was created, {later}. Delete the draft and create the statement again.
statements_later_sent: Since this statement was created, {later}. Correct sent statements outside Dwello: send the tenant a corrected statement with the receipt. Whether you can still claim the costs is not certain in every case: if in doubt, get advice.
statements_pdf_failed_reason: The PDF could not be created: {reason}
statements_pdf_failed: The PDF could not be created. Please try again.
statements_delete_text: Statement {number} for {tenant} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
statements_rental_days_label: Days rented in the billing period
statements_reminder_by_email: Dwello creates «{next}» as a PDF and sends it by email to {email}.
statements_reminder_by_letter: Dwello creates «{next}» as a PDF and puts it under «Documents». Mark the letter as sent there on the day you post it. Then print it and send it by post.
statements_no_more_reminders_text: 3 reminders have already been sent. Dwello cannot create another one. Agree on the next steps directly with the tenant.
statements_reminder_257d: A reminder from Dwello is a request for payment. It does not set a payment deadline with a warning of termination under Art. 257d CO. Further steps, e.g. debt collection proceedings or termination for payment arrears under Art. 257d CO, take place outside Dwello. For this termination, you first set the tenant a payment deadline of at least 30 days in a separate letter, with a warning that you will terminate the lease. Seek advice.
statements_reminder_undelivered: The document «{title}» is ready to send under «Documents». {reason}
statements_reminder_emailed: The document «{title}» was sent by email.
statements_reminder_letter: The document «{title}» is ready to print as a letter under «Documents».
statements_no_lines: No statement lines: no invoices were added for this billing period.
statements_send_text_1: Dwello does not send the statement itself. Deliver the PDF to the tenant and then mark the statement as sent.
statements_send_text_2: Dwello dates the statement on the day you mark it as sent. So deliver the PDF on the same day.
statements_summary_due: The tenant pays the amount due of {amount}.
statements_pdf_view_failed: The PDF could not be created. Close this tab and try again later.
statements_save_failed: The statement could not be saved.
statements_refund_by_help: By this date you refund the amount to the tenant.
statements_deadline_help: By this date the tenant pays the amount due.
statements_notes_help: For example an agreement with the tenant.
statements_recalculate_hint: Costs and the management fee are calculated when the statements are created and cannot be changed here. To correct them, delete the draft and create the building’s statements again.
statements_generate_purpose: Create the utility cost statements of a billing period for whole buildings. This creates drafts that you then check and send.
statements_confirm_needed: Confirm that the statements should be created anyway.
statements_nothing: Choose another billing period or other buildings, or first delete the drafts you want to recalculate.
statements_resume: With «Next», Dwello calculates the preview with the new invoice.
statements_draft_dropped_building_one: A building from your entries no longer exists. Dwello removed it from the selection. Check the buildings in step {number} «{step}».
statements_draft_dropped_building_many: {count} buildings from your entries no longer exist. Dwello removed them from the selection. Check the buildings in step {number} «{step}».
statements_draft_dropped_heating_profile: The heating profile from your entries no longer exists. Choose another one in step {number} «{step}».
statements_building_billed_one: Of {total} rental contracts in this billing period, {billed} already has a statement that covers all or part of this period.
statements_building_billed_many: Of {total} rental contracts in this billing period, {billed} already have a statement that covers all or part of this period.
statements_building_billed_all_one: The only rental contract in this billing period already has a statement that covers all or part of this period. No new statement is created for this building. You do not need to choose it.
statements_building_billed_all_many: All rental contracts in this billing period already have a statement that covers all or part of this period. No new statement is created for this building. You do not need to choose it.
statements_period_proposed: The proposal is the last completed billing period from the settings.
statements_period_running_text: The billing period has not ended yet. The statements count the advance payments for all months, including those not yet paid, and invoices up to the end of the period are still missing. Create the statements only after the period has ended.
statements_preview_running_text: The billing period has not ended yet. The advance payment counts for all months, including those not yet paid, and invoices up to the end of the period are still missing. Create the statements only after the period has ended.
statements_building_no_invoices: No invoices added in the billing period
statements_heating_help: Spreads the heating costs over the months when tenants change; choose the profile your rental contracts provide for. Dwello spreads by the heating profile and cannot take meter readings into account. If the heating or hot water meters in the apartment were read when the tenants changed, those values apply: then create the statement of this apartment outside Dwello and delete the drafts of all rental contracts of this apartment, even if you create the statements again later. If your building has heat or hot water meters or heat cost allocators (small devices on the radiators) in the apartments, you usually have to bill by consumption. Dwello cannot do this: then create the statements outside Dwello. Only heating profiles adding up to 100 % can be chosen.
statements_fee_help: Percentage of the own utility costs of each tenant whose rental contract agrees a management fee. Up to {max} % is usual. If the rental contract states its own rate, that rate applies. Without an agreed management fee the statement contains none.
statements_fee_above_text: The management fee is higher than the usual guideline of {max} %. Check whether the extra work justifies it.
statements_tank_title: Do you heat with oil, LPG, pellets or wood?
statements_tank_text: Then add the fuel stock at the start and end of the period, otherwise Dwello bills the purchases instead of the consumption. With district heating, mains gas or a heat pump there is nothing to do.
statements_vacancy_note: The landlord bears the share of vacant apartments; it is not included in this amount.
statements_fee_of_own: {percent} % of the own utility costs of each tenant with an agreed management fee. An own rate in the rental contract takes precedence.
statements_missing_text: No invoices have been added for {names} in the billing period. Without invoices their costs are missing from the statements, and the tenants get most of their advance payment back. Add the invoices first – or confirm below that there are none.
statements_existing_text: For {name}, this billing period already has {statements}.
statements_existing_note: Rental contracts with a statement in this period do not get a new one. To recalculate a draft, delete it and create the statements again.
statements_partial_title: Invoices for only part of the period
statements_partial_text: For {names} there are more than three months without an invoice at the start or end of the billing period. Check whether invoices are still missing.
statements_preview_empty: In this billing period there are no rental contracts without a statement in the chosen buildings.
statements_all_billed: All rental contracts already have a statement in this period. To recalculate a draft, delete it and create the statements again. Sent statements cannot be recalculated.
statements_compared_title: Costs compared with the previous year
statements_compared_text: Dwello compares each category with the same period of the previous year{compared}. A hint does not mean that something is wrong: perhaps the invoice comes later, or the supplier bills differently.
statements_missing_consequence: If an invoice is missing, its costs are missing from every statement of the building. Later you can claim them only with a corrected statement, and not in every case.
statements_add_missing: Add missing invoices – or confirm below that everything is correct.
statements_check_stocks_text: Add or check the fuel stocks – or confirm below that everything is correct.
statements_will_create_one: 1 utility cost statement will be created as a draft.
statements_will_create_many: {count} utility cost statements will be created as drafts.
statements_nothing_sent: Nothing is sent. You then check each statement and send it individually.
statements_without_invoices_text: {names}: these statements are created without invoices. They share out CHF 0.00 of utility costs, and every tenant gets their advance payment back.
statements_incomplete_text: {names}: a draft only uses the invoices added now. If an invoice is missing, its costs are missing from every statement of the building.
statements_created_one: 1 utility cost statement has been created as a draft.
statements_created_many: {count} utility cost statements have been created as drafts.
statements_check_drafts: Check the drafts and then send them.

backend_jwt_error: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
backend_unknown_error: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
backend_internal_error: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
backend_proxy_error: The request could not be processed. Please try again.
backend_validation_error: The request was invalid. Reload the page and try again.
backend_network_error: No connection to the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
backend_service_unavailable: The server is not responding. Please try again in a moment.
backend_gateway_timeout: The server took too long to respond. Please try again.
config_help_heating_profile: Spreads the heating costs over the 12 months in percent. If a tenant moves in or out during the billing period, their heating costs are calculated by month instead of by day – more heating is used in winter than in summer.
config_help_distribution_key: Decides how a building’s costs are shared among the apartments, for example by area, by rooms or in equal parts. Every allocable invoice can have a distribution key; without one it is shared equally per apartment.
config_help_management_fee: Compensation for your work on the utility costs: a percentage of the own utility costs of each tenant whose rental contract agrees a management fee. About 3 % is usual; a higher rate must match your actual work. Dwello accepts at most 10 %.
config_help_accounting_period: The period for which you bill the utility costs, for example calendar year (01.01.–31.12.), July–June or November–October.
settings_purpose: Sender for statements and reminders, suggestions for new statements and invoices, and the master data.
settings_sender_text: Appears on every statement and every reminder. Dwello uses the IBAN to create the QR-bill.
settings_iban_help: Account to which your tenants transfer amounts due; it appears on the QR-bill. You transfer a refund yourself to the tenant’s account by the payment deadline; the statement asks the tenant to give you their IBAN.
settings_fee_suggestion: Suggested when you create the statements, where you can change it for each run.
settings_saved_text: Sender, management fee and suggestions saved.
settings_error_iban: Please enter a valid Swiss IBAN
settings_save_failed: The settings could not be saved.
settings_link_categories: Cost types you sort invoices by
settings_link_keys: How the costs are shared among the apartments
settings_link_profiles: How the heating costs are spread over the months
settings_suggestions_text: Dwello suggests these values. You can change them each time you create statements and add invoices.
settings_period_suggested: The last completed period is suggested.
settings_profile_complete_only: Only heating profiles whose monthly shares add up to 100 % can be chosen.
settings_key_suggested: The distribution key chosen here is suggested when you add new invoices.
keys_not_saved: The distribution key was not saved
keys_not_deleted: The distribution key was not deleted
profiles_not_saved: The heating profile was not saved
profiles_not_deleted: The heating profile was not deleted
categories_purpose: Categories sort invoices by cost type. Only costs from allocable categories go into the utility cost statement; the landlord bears the rest.
categories_in_use_note: Categories that invoices are already sorted into cannot be deleted.
categories_delete_text: The category disappears from the choices when you add invoices.
categories_description_predefined: The list does not show the description of predefined categories.
categories_allocable_help: Costs linked to the use of the property are allocable (Art. 257a–257b CO), e.g. heating, water, caretaker. Repairs, renewals, building insurance and taxes are borne by the landlord; for the heating and the lift only operation and servicing of the system count. For water, waste water and waste, base fees that depend on the value of the property do not count; for waste water the rainwater fee does not count either. The tenant pays allocable costs only if the rental contract names them as utility costs (Art. 257a para. 2 CO).
categories_reason_heating: Fuel, energy, servicing and operation of the heating are allocable (Art. 5 VMWG); repair, renewal, interest and depreciation of the system are not (Art. 6 VMWG).
categories_reason_hot_water: Energy and operation of the central hot water supply are allocable (Art. 5 para. 1 VMWG); repair and renewal of the system are not (Art. 6 VMWG).
categories_reason_cold_water: The water used is linked to the use (Art. 257b para. 1 CO); base fees that depend on the value of the property are not.
categories_reason_wastewater: The fee by consumption is linked to the use (Art. 257b para. 1 CO); the rainwater fee and base fees that depend on the value of the property are not.
categories_reason_common_electricity: Electricity for shared rooms and outdoor lighting is linked to the use.
categories_reason_elevator: Electricity, emergency phone and servicing of the lift are linked to the use; repairs, spare parts and service contracts with repairs are borne by the landlord.
categories_reason_caretaker: Cleaning, running the heating and minor upkeep are linked to the use; administration and repairs are not.
categories_reason_garden: Ongoing care of the grounds is linked to the use; new planting and purchases are not.
categories_reason_snow: Snow clearing and gritting are linked to the use; buying equipment is not.
categories_reason_waste: Waste fees that arise from the use (e.g. a base fee per apartment, a container by weight) are allocable (Art. 257b para. 1 CO); base fees that depend on the value of the property and clearances the landlord orders are not.
categories_reason_tv: The ongoing base fee of the cable network is linked to the use; installing the connection is not.
categories_reason_chimney: Cleaning the chimney and the heating system is part of the heating costs (Art. 5 para. 2 let. d VMWG).
categories_reason_repairs: The landlord must keep the property fit for use (Art. 256 para. 1 CO). Repairs are covered by the rent, not by the utility costs.
categories_reason_building_insurance: The premiums are among the burdens of the property that the landlord bears (Art. 256b CO).
categories_reason_property_tax: Taxes on the property are borne by the landlord (Art. 256b CO).
categories_reason_mortgage: Financing the property is not linked to the use; it is covered by the rent.
categories_reason_administration: General administration is covered by the rent. The work for the utility cost statement can be charged through the management fee (Art. 4 para. 3 VMWG) if the rental contract names it (Art. 257a para. 2 CO); administrative work for running the heating is part of the heating costs (Art. 5 para. 2 VMWG).
categories_reason_renovation: Renovations keep the building fit for use; that is the landlord’s duty (Art. 256 para. 1 CO) and covered by the rent. The part that adds value can justify a rent increase, not utility costs.
categories_reason_capital_improvements: Investments increase the value of the property; they are not linked to the use and are not utility costs. They can justify a rent increase (Art. 269a let. b CO, Art. 14 VMWG).
categories_reason_pest_control: It preserves the building and is needed even when it stands empty; its costs are not linked to the use.
categories_reason_fire_extinguisher: Fire protection is needed even when the building stands empty; the servicing is not linked to the use.
categories_contract_note: The tenant pays allocable costs only if the rental contract names them as utility costs (Art. 257a para. 2 CO).
categories_heating: Spread heating costs by the heating profile
categories_heating_help: For example heating oil, district heating, pellets or the chimney sweep. If a tenant moves in or out during the billing period, Dwello spreads these costs over the months by the heating profile, all others by day. Separately billed hot water is used about evenly all year: leave the box unticked for it.
categories_sort_order_help: Position in the selection lists and in the list of categories: smaller numbers appear higher up; with the same number, the name decides.
categories_translations_help: The category’s name in French, Italian and English. The utility cost statement of a tenant with that language shows it, and so does Dwello in that language. Without it, the German name appears.
categories_new_purpose: A cost type you sort invoices by.
keys_note: Predefined distribution keys cannot be changed. Custom distribution keys that invoices are already distributed by cannot be deleted.
keys_delete_text: The distribution key disappears from the choices when you add invoices.
keys_formula_help: Decides each apartment’s share of the costs. Insert building blocks with the buttons and calculate with + - * / and brackets.
keys_var_units: 1 for each apartment, all pay the same
keys_total_area: Sum of the living areas of all apartments
keys_total_rooms: Sum of the rooms of all apartments
keys_total_volume: Sum of the room volumes of all apartments
keys_total_units: Number of apartments in the building
keys_example_area: By living area: an apartment of 100 m² pays twice as much as one of 50 m².
keys_example_rooms: By number of rooms: an apartment with 4 rooms pays twice as much as one with 2 rooms.
keys_example_units: In equal parts, e.g. for the cable connection.
keys_example_mixed: Area and rooms together: each room counts as 10 m² of extra area.
keys_example_fixed: Fixed parts: 70 % of the costs by area, 30 % in equal parts per apartment.
keys_help_intro: The formula gives a number for each apartment. Each apartment pays the part of the costs that its number makes up of the sum for all apartments. Example with
keys_help_example: : apartment A has 50 m², apartment B 100 m², together 150 m². A pays one third of the costs, B two thirds.
keys_totals_text: For keys made of fixed parts, divide a building block by its total.
keys_calculate_text: + plus, - minus, * times, / divided by. What is in brackets is calculated first. Write decimals with a point, e.g. 0.5.
keys_test_caption: How the costs would be shared among four sample apartments
keys_predefined_not_editable: Predefined distribution keys cannot be edited
keys_save_failed: The distribution key could not be saved.
keys_delete_failed: The distribution key could not be deleted.
keys_new_purpose: A formula of your own by which costs are shared among the apartments of a building.
profiles_empty_text: Add a heating profile so that the heating costs are spread by month when the tenant changes.
profiles_shares_legend: Share of the heating costs per month in %
profiles_shares_help: The monthly shares spread a year’s heating costs and add up to 100 %. More heating is used in winter than in summer.
profiles_shares_keep: Existing statements keep the monthly shares they were created with. To recalculate drafts, delete the drafts of all rental contracts of the affected apartments in the billing period concerned and create the statements again. Sent statements cannot be recalculated.
profiles_chart_caption: Share of the heating costs per month
profiles_predefined_note: Follows common practice and cannot be changed.
profiles_delete_text: Statements already created keep their heating cost distribution.
profiles_predefined_not_editable: Predefined heating profiles cannot be edited
profiles_new_purpose: Set how a year’s heating costs are spread over the months, e.g. for a building in the mountains with a long heating season.
profiles_save_failed: The heating profile could not be saved.
profiles_delete_failed: The heating profile could not be deleted.
reports_purpose: Annual reports and exports for your buildings.
reports_soon_text: Annual reports and exports as Excel or PDF are planned for a later version. You can already find deadlines and figures for your buildings in the overview.
analytics_purpose: Analyses of the income and costs of your buildings.
analytics_soon_text: Analyses of income, costs by category and forecasts are planned for a later version. You can already find deadlines and figures for your buildings in the overview.
gallery_purpose: All components of the design system in every state.
gallery_toast_error: The statement could not be saved. Please try again.
gallery_toast_warning: The management fee is above the usual guideline of 3 %.
gallery_street_error: Please enter the street, for example Musterstrasse 12.
gallery_rent_help: The monthly rent without utility costs, in CHF.
gallery_reason_error: Please give the reason for the change.
gallery_duration_question: How long does the rental contract run?
gallery_unlimited_text: The rental contract has no contract end.
gallery_limited_text: The rental contract ends on a fixed date.
gallery_channel_error: Please choose how the tenant receives post.
gallery_drafts_text: The statements are created as drafts. You can check them before sending.
gallery_no_invoices_text: No invoices have been added for the billing period {year}.
gallery_check_text: Please check the details and try again.
gallery_first_tenant: Add your first tenant. You can then create a rental contract.
gallery_delete_tenant_text: {name} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
gallery_mark_sent_text: After that you can no longer edit or delete the statement.
contracts_end_missing: Please enter the contract end, for example {example}.
contracts_end_before_start_on: The contract end cannot be before the contract start on {date}.
contracts_end_past_confirm: Please confirm that the rental contract ended on {date}, or correct the contract end.
contracts_billed_locked_one: The utility cost statement {numbers} was calculated with the previous contract dates.
contracts_billed_locked_many: The utility cost statements {numbers} were calculated with the previous contract dates.
contracts_billed_locked_rest: Dwello does not change them, so the date cannot be saved. Check the date. If it is correct, settle the correction of the statement directly with the tenant.
contracts_billed_draft_one: The utility cost statement {number} (draft) was calculated with the previous contract dates. You can delete the draft below and then create the utility cost statement again.
contracts_billed_draft_many: The utility cost statements {numbers} (drafts) were calculated with the previous contract dates. First delete the drafts, then create the utility cost statements again.
contracts_end_changed_again: The contract end has changed. Confirm it again with the checkbox.
contracts_end_in_past: The contract end is in the past. Confirm the contract end with the checkbox.
contracts_end_in_past_long: The contract end is in the past, more than a year ago. Check the year. Confirm the contract end with the checkbox.
contracts_end_confirm_help: From {date} the apartment counts as not let, unless a new rental contract has started. The landlord bears the utility costs of this time; the tenant’s advance payment counts only up to the contract end.
contracts_end_already_set: The rental contract already has a contract end. Change it under «Edit».
contracts_delete_future_text: The rental contract of {name} has not started yet and will be deleted permanently.
contracts_delete_started_text: The rental contract of {name} started on {date}. Delete it only if it was recorded by mistake, for example for the wrong apartment or the wrong tenant. If only one value is wrong, correct it under «Edit».
contracts_delete_real_tenancy: If {name} really rented the apartment, do not delete the rental contract: when the tenant moves out, choose «End contract». An ended rental contract stays in the apartment’s history.
contracts_delete_missing_statements: Utility cost statements are still missing for this rental contract. Once it is deleted, Dwello no longer reminds you of them.
contracts_delete_mistake_label: This rental contract was recorded by mistake.
contracts_delete_mistake_help: Its days rented then count as vacancy, unless another rental contract covers that time.
contracts_delete_mistake_unconfirmed: Please confirm that this rental contract was recorded by mistake, or cancel.
contracts_delete_billed: This rental contract cannot be deleted. Its days rented are billed in:
contracts_delete_no_statements: There is no utility cost statement in Dwello for this rental contract.
contracts_delete_billed_drafts: First delete the drafts, then the rental contract can be deleted.
contracts_delete_billed_locked: A sent or paid statement stays, and with it the rental contract. Settle any correction directly with the tenant.
contracts_delete_real_tenancy_ended: If {name} really rented the apartment, do not delete the rental contract: its contract end is {date}, after that it stays in the apartment’s history.
backend_contract_has_statements: This rental contract cannot be deleted because a utility cost statement bills its days rented. Reload the page to see it.
backend_contract_started: The rental contract has started in the meantime. Reload the page and confirm when deleting that it was recorded by mistake.
contracts_ended_toast: The rental contract of {name} ended on {date}
contracts_ends_on_toast: The rental contract of {name} ends on {date}
contracts_end_date_help: The last day of the tenancy, that is the termination date. The rental contract runs up to and including this day, even if the tenant moves out earlier.
contracts_end_notice_hint: Check the notice period and date in the rental contract: for apartments the notice period is at least 3 months. If the notice comes too late, it only applies to the next termination date. A new rental contract can start on the day after.
contracts_notice_received_help: The day the letter of notice arrived. The tenant’s notice of termination must be in writing. For a family home, the express consent of the spouse or registered partner is needed.
contracts_notice_period_short: There are less than 3 months between receipt and the end of the contract. The notice of termination then probably only applies to the next termination date. Exception: a replacement tenant takes over the rental contract, or you agreed on the end with the tenant.
statements_deadline_missing: The deadline is missing. Please enter a date.
contracts_duration_terminated_help: The rental contract ends with the notice of termination. If the termination date has moved, change the contract end.
contracts_withdraw_notice_help: The rental contract then runs on without an end. This is only possible if tenant and landlord withdraw the notice of termination together, or if the conciliation authority or a court declares it invalid. Once received, a notice cannot be withdrawn by the tenant or the landlord alone.
contracts_notice_withdrawn_toast: Notice of termination of {name} withdrawn. The rental contract runs on without an end.
backend_contract_notice_without_end: A notice of termination needs a contract end. Enter the termination date.
backend_contract_parties_fixed: The tenant and the apartment of a rental contract cannot be changed. Give this rental contract a contract end and add a new rental contract.
dashboard_task_successor: Find a new tenant for apartment {apartment}
dashboard_task_successor_text: The rental contract of {name} ends on {date}. Find a new tenant and record their rental contract.
contracts_next_steps_text: The rental contract has been terminated. Record the new tenant’s rental contract as soon as it is signed. The final statement needs the tenant’s new address.
contracts_statement_missing_text: The rental contract has days rented in this billing period but no utility cost statement yet. The wizard creates the statements of all rental contracts of the building. Enter the invoices of the period first.
contracts_statements_missing_text: The rental contract has days rented in these billing periods but no utility cost statement in Dwello yet. Each button opens the wizard for all rental contracts of the building in this period. Enter the invoices of the period first; you can start with any period.
contracts_delete_draft_consequence: The draft {number} will be deleted. Then create the utility cost statement again.
contracts_delete_draft_and_end: Delete draft and end rental contract
contracts_delete_draft_and_save: Delete draft and save rental contract
contracts_draft_deleted_toast: Draft {number} deleted. The rental contract of {name} ends on {date}. Now create the utility cost statement again.
statements_preset_from_statements: The heating profile and management fee are set like the other utility cost statements of this billing period. Check them and go on to the preview.
statements_preset_from_settings: The heating profile and management fee come from the settings. Check them and go on to the preview.
statements_preset_profile_from_statement: The heating profile is set like the other utility cost statements of this billing period, the management fee comes from the settings. Check them and go on to the preview.
statements_profile_reason_whole_period: rental contract over the whole period
statements_profile_reason_no_heating_mon: the months of the billing period total 0 % in the heating profile
contracts_next_steps_text_successor: The rental contract has been terminated and the new tenant is recorded. The final statement needs the tenant’s new address.
contracts_next_steps_hint: You can see the next steps at the top of the page.
contracts_apartment_contracts_unknown_te: Dwello could not load the rental contracts for this apartment. Choose «Try again»; your entries are kept. When you save, Dwello always checks whether the period overlaps with another rental contract for this apartment.
contracts_apartment_contracts_loaded: The apartment’s rental contracts are loaded.
contracts_apartment_contracts_retry_fail: The apartment’s rental contracts still could not be loaded. Try again later; your entries are kept.
contracts_apartment_contracts_see_apartm: The rental contracts for this apartment are still missing, see the apartment above.
contracts_delete_draft_contracts_unknown: Dwello did not delete the draft: without the rental contracts for this apartment an overlap cannot be ruled out. Choose «Try again» at the apartment, then «Delete draft and save rental contract» again.
contracts_apartment_contracts_loading: The apartment’s rental contracts are still loading. Try again in a moment.
contracts_notice_hint_text: Then enter the contract end on the rental contract page with «End contract». It stays open-ended, and Dwello names the next steps.
tenants_document_file_help: PDF, JPG or PNG, at most 10 MB. Delete copies of ID documents and debt collection register extracts as soon as you no longer need them.
tenants_document_title_help: Without a title, the document is named after the file, without its extension.
tenants_document_demo: Every visitor sees the files you upload here. Upload only made-up documents.
tenants_document_upload_failed: The document was not saved because Dwello did not answer. Choose «Upload document» again.
tenants_document_delete_text: Document «{title}» will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
tenants_document_delete_failed: The document was not deleted. Try again.
tenants_delete_text_with_documents: {name} will be deleted permanently, together with the uploaded documents. This cannot be undone.
backend_document_too_large: The file is larger than {megabytes} MB. Choose a smaller file or reduce the size of the scan.
backend_document_type_not_allowed: Dwello accepts only PDF, JPG and PNG files. Save the file as a PDF and choose it again.
backend_document_not_deletable: Reminders are kept because they prove that the tenant was reminded.
documents_empty_to_send_text: Letters you have to print and post appear here.
tenants_delete_has_contracts_documents: Tenants with rental contracts are kept because statements and documents refer to them. The documents you uploaded for this tenant stay saved too. Delete them one by one under «Documents» on this page as soon as you no longer need them.
backend_document_title_too_long: The title is longer than {max} characters. Shorten it.
backend_tenant_not_found: This tenant no longer exists. They were probably deleted in another window. Open the list «Tenants».
categories_error_allocable_required: Choose whether the costs are allocable.
backend_ki_proposal_unavailable: The AI cannot be reached. Try again later or decide yourself whether the costs are allocable.
backend_ki_proposal_unsure: The AI is not sure. Decide yourself whether the costs are allocable.
categories_allocable_yes: The costs go into the utility cost statement.
categories_allocable_no: The costs are borne by the landlord.
categories_proposal_checking: The AI is checking the category …
categories_proposal_applied: Dwello has preselected this choice. You decide: check the reasoning and change the choice if it does not fit.
categories_proposal_kept: Your choice stays. Compare it with the AI’s reasoning.
